articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - New Era Energy Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) (“New Era” or the “Company”), a developer of next-generation digital infrastructure and integrated power assets, today announced it has entered into a securities purchase agreement for a private investment in public equity financing (the “PIPE”) that is expected to result in gross proceeds of approximately $64 million. The PIPE is expected to close on October 30, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions. Pursuant to the terms of the securities purchase agreement, at the closing of the PIPE, New Era will issue an aggregate of 23,272,727 shares of common stock at a price of $2.75 per share. “We executed this capital raise in order to strengthen our financial position in a challenging market and meet our near-term financing needs, allowing us to advance leasing negotiations for 757 MW across Phases 1 and 2 at Texas Critical Data Centers (“TCDC”),” said Charlie
articles.title: New Era Energy & Digital Announces $64 Million Private Placement of Common Stock
